description: DSv4-Flash ds4 engine, serveable TODAY (kernel inventory as of 2026-07): routed-expert tensors run on the IQ2_XXS / Q2_K MMVQ paths or the native MXFP4 grid; attention, shared-expert, and dense tensors run ONLY on the FP8 tensor-core path (MXFP8_E4M3 group-32 re-encode). No IQ2_XS / IQ2_S / Q3_K expert kernels exist, and non-expert tensors have no IQ/k-quant path at all. Use the 'ds4' union profile to price what the CONTAINER could carry; use this profile to price what the engine can serve.

format_rules.detail: routed-expert tensors: engine kernels exist only for IQ2_XXS, Q2_K, and the checkpoint-native MXFP4 grid (no IQ2_XS/IQ2_S/Q3_K expert kernels)
attention / shared-expert / dense tensors are served only on the FP8 tensor-core path (MXFP8_E4M3 group-32); no IQ/k-quant kernels exist for them

shape_rules.detail: GGUF k-quants and 256-superblock IQ types pack 256-element superblocks along the input dim
OCP MX formats scale 32-element groups (E8M0 per-group scale) along the input dim
